(Photo by Johnnie Izquierdo/Getty Images)Johnnie Izquierdo/Getty ImagesThe United States Women’s National Team’s 2026 soccer season is underway.Keep WatchingWatch MoreThe USWNT continued its schedule in March with the SheBelieves Cup, registering wins against Argentina, Canada and Colombia to claim its eighth title in the annual tournament. The USWNT next plays Saturday against Japan.AdvertisementArticle continues below this adGet Digital Access and Stay Informed With Trusted Local News.Get Digital Access and Stay Informed With Trusted Local News.ONLY 25¢The trio of victories improved the USWNT to 5-0 this year, following wins against Paraguay and Chile in January.
